subject: live evidence is 5 days stale, and it is holding the company readiness figure at 0%
body:
artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json was minted 2026-09-12 against sync-manifest fingerprint 4afa60cf2fd5. Mainline now reports 6906d8d9ecc5, so check-readiness-figure.mjs fail-closes dimension (b) to 0% and the HEADLINE reads 0% - OUTREACH CLOSED - while (a) and (c) both read 100%. Nothing is broken and no branch caused it: the evidence simply predates the tree.

Only this machine can lift it. On the Mac:

  SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=/path/to/signalgrid-mcp pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence

It refuses on CI and refuses unless both halves are green, which is the point - a re-mint over a partial run would bind fresh evidence to an unproven tree.

THE REASON THIS IS MAIL AND NOT ONLY A SIM REQUEST: I queued artifacts/sim-requests/2026-09-18-evidence-remint-readiness-b.json for exactly this, but it is on an unmerged branch (#821), and the tick runs sim:run-requests against mainline. A request the tick cannot see is a request nobody will run. If #821 lands first, the tick will pick it up on its own and this mail is redundant; until then it is the only path that reaches you.

Also worth knowing: seven old conflicted PRs were replayed onto current mainline tonight (#815, #817, #818, #819, #820, #821, #822). Every one of them turned up a defect the original branch could not have seen, and two are in gates you rely on - the merge authorizer classified a quoted path as autonomous, and the fabricated-status detector depended on object key order.
